_about: Real photos for the Facebook Page albums, with search words in the caption and alt text. Uploaded by bin/page-profile.mjs photos (workflow ig-auto-page-profile.yml); each file is uploaded once (page-photos-ledger.jsonl). Only real photos of our boat and coast, faces not the focus.

albums.name: Private boat trips from Funchal, Madeira
albums.message: Our boat, our coast: Cabo Girão, Câmara de Lobos, Fajã dos Padres and Marina do Funchal, seen from a private boat trip.
